documentation.content: Cloud Scheduler tried to start the nightly database export (alyr-db-export-nightly, 02:00 Doha) and was refused or got an error. First step: Cloud Scheduler > alyr-db-export-nightly > Logs; the usual causes are the alyr-export account losing roles/run.invoker on the job, or the job being deleted. A failed run of the export itself is caught by the errors alert. Run the job by hand with `gcloud run jobs execute alyr-db-export --region me-central1`.
